numberPrefix.title: Order number prefix
numberPrefix.description: Put before every order number (for example SHOP-). Order numbers are <prefix><year>-<number>.

messageChannels.title: Order messages by
messageChannels.description: How shoppers get order messages, through Notifications.

notifyStatuses.title: Statuses that send a message
notifyStatuses.description: Status keys of your order flow; moving an order into one of them sends the shopper a message.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods offered
paymentMethods.description: Online payment and bank transfer go through Payments (paste its token in Connections); pay at pickup needs a pickup location. Cash on delivery is its own feature.

paymentWindowMinutes.title: Time to pay (minutes)
paymentWindowMinutes.description: An order paid online or by bank transfer (or a cash-on-delivery advance) that is not paid within this time is cancelled and its stock given back.

confirmationHours.title: Time to confirm (hours)
confirmationHours.description: A cash-on-delivery or pay-at-pickup order your staff do not confirm within this time is cancelled and its stock given back.

openOrderCap.title: Waiting orders per customer
openOrderCap.description: A customer may have at most this many orders waiting for payment or confirmation (0 = no limit).

addressRequired.title: Also required in the address
addressRequired.description: Name, phone, address line 1 and city are always required.
